written_before: any training run on this dataset; the numbers below were fixed while only the dataset census (row/action counts) was known

training.selection: the trainer keeps the epoch with the lowest mean validation loss over supervised validation windows
training.no_tuning: no learning rate, arm or epoch count is chosen after looking at validation or test accuracy; the config above is executed once

evaluation.population: supervised rows inside the scored burnin16/sequence32 windows of the named split
metrics: class-balanced accuracy (mean per-class recall over the classes present)
action-change accuracy (rows whose action differs from the previous row's actual action)
hold-last baseline (predict the previous row's actual action)
majority-class baseline (most frequent action in the train split)
diagnostics: playfield-zeroed ablation accuracy (a policy reading the HUD instead of the bullets does not drop)
supervision census per event: rows, annotated, supervised, action histogram, action changes
evaluation.claim_limitation: A few hundred supervised rows from three replays of one stage measure a signal and a pipeline, not gameplay skill, generalization or a deployable policy.
evaluation.reporting_order: validation is reported first; the train/validation decision is frozen in the run report before any test number exists

test_policy.isolation: the test split is excluded from the feature cache (report shows test_tensor_loaded=false, test_cache_created=false); the trainer never loads it
test_policy.single_read: test is evaluated at most once, by a separate invocation that writes a new file and refuses to overwrite
preconditions: validation metrics exist for the selected checkpoint
the run report shows test_used=false and backbone_unchanged=true
no threshold, sample or protocol change has been made after the validation numbers
test_policy.if_preconditions_fail: the test split is reported as not evaluated, not as passed

stop_conditions: any exact audit, identity, alignment or pixel-binding failure
fewer than three independent replay source groups
NaN or non-finite loss, updates=0, or a changed backbone
test consulted before this file was frozen
